results.title: El Frío Que Guía Luz
results.overview: While waiting for the bus, a single mother is suddenly swept into her painful past as she tells her six-year-old daughter a tale.

results.title: Jie
results.overview: A young Chinese boy, Jie, navigates a new life in the U.S. while facing quiet family tensions and begins to grow through an unexpected friendship.

results.title: Little Birds
results.overview: Two girls escape from their bleak world into one of their own; but when their game of flight takes a dark turn, one is left to face the consequences alone.

results.title: The Life Cycle of a Grey Ant
results.original_title: Le cycle de vie des fourmis grises
results.overview: Blending fiction and dance, THE LIFE CYCLE OF A GREY ANT is a retro-futuristic ballet that flips a middle finger to modernity.

results.title: Whiskey Throttle
results.overview: When a lone outsider infiltrates a cartel-run motocross empire and walks away with its kingpin's fortune, he becomes the target of a deadly pursuit stretching 100 miles across the desert to the border.

results.title: A Mourning Star
results.overview: Our story follows a young boy lost in a forest who encounters a mysterious fallen star. The star offers to guide him home but as their journey unfolds, it becomes clear that things aren’t quite as simple as they seem.

results.title: Eclipse
results.overview: In a near future, humanity has blotted out the sun with an artificial cloud in an attempt to stop climate collapse, and the world has lost its color. A photographer wanders this gray, lifeless landscape, obsessively searching for one last sign of life. When he meets a mysterious girl, he may finally have the chance to take the photograph he has been chasing all his life.

results.title: Encyclopedia Galactica
results.overview: In ancient days, humans would look at the stars and dream of an endless future; every point of light emblematic of a new horizon to cross, a new frontier to conquer, a destiny to claim. But this future would not come to pass. Instead, the future would see the human race gone, our pan-galactic society torn apart by the strains of expansion. The planets settled during humanity’s diaspora lay abandoned, with all traces of our presence eroding into ruin and dust; an ancient cosmic ecosystem swallowing our collective remains. And despite our absence, those hopeful, naive dreams of that now-ancient era still echo across the galaxy, for any who choose to intercept them.

results.title: Red Ledger
results.overview: Captain Georgina Lee captures and interrogates Ellis's handler on why she was sent to disarm weapons. But a piece of Lee's history is brought up that she can't escape.

results.title: Contact
results.overview: Contact is a documentary film that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument, where skate, BMX, art and music scenes collide.

results.title: Oscillations
results.overview: Oscillations is an experimental animated short constructed from a filmed live oscilloscope performance combining synthesized sampling, live guitar and analog signal imagery. Continuing the tradition of visual music explored by pioneers such as Oskar Fischinger, the work transforms sound into shifting geometric forms and rhythmic electronic landscapes. Utilizing William S. Burroughs’ cut-up method, fragments of text derived from the “Pale Blue Dot” passage in Cosmos are recombined into evolving poetic structures. Through repetition, fragmentation and oscillation, the piece gradually shifts from cosmic reflection toward an inquiry into memory, place and the unstable idea of home.

results.title: Seeing Thru Imperfect Glass
results.overview: Broken glass, plastic prisms and warped reflections are accented by a guitar and banjo soundtrack in Seeing Thru Imperfect Glass. The rigid control of cinematic sight is released with this in-camera edited double exposed film.

results.title: Mother Nature
results.overview: Mother Nature is an abstract exploration of the natural world and its ongoing struggle for survival. Shot on 16mm, the film uses texture, movement and form to express the tension between resilience and destruction within nature’s fragile ecosystems. The film has been physically altered through a series of material interventions—baked in an oven, bleached, hand-painted and scratched—transforming the celluloid itself to mirror the erosion, violence and beauty found in nature’s own processes. The experimental soundtrack was created by capturing the hidden sounds of plants through sensitive microphones, amplifying the subtle vibrations and internal rhythms of organic life.

results.title: Land of Enchantment
results.overview: Land of Enchantment explores the quiet majesty of northern New Mexico. Inspired by the legacy of early landscape photographers, the film approaches the region not as a travelogue but as a visual study of light, land and time.

results.title: Redwood Understory
results.overview: Redwood Understory is an exploration of the flora, fauna and fungi of the redwood forest. Filmed in 16mm in extreme close-up, in short bursts, the film gives the feeling of exploring the forest floor on hands and knees, blinking at the wonders illuminated by the shifting light.

results.title: The Doll Walk
results.overview: When the government attempts to erase trans identities, a group of trans women takes to the streets of New York City, demanding a future where trans people can exist on their own terms.

results.title: ¿Querés ser mi hijo?
results.overview: Lucía, a 42-year-old woman, discovers her partner's infidelity after a 15-year relationship and must reorganize her personal and professional life. She asks her young neighbor to pretend to be her son for a job opportunity.

results.title: Delta
results.overview: Felipe and Rosario are isolated in a house by the river, far from the city. However, a sinister presence already dwells within them.

results.title: Aktos
results.overview: Twelve-year-old Batyr has been secretly working on a daring project with only his loyal dog, Aktos, by his side. When a sudden crisis threatens his plan, Batyr must race against time to finish it before it's too late.
